summary: Crescent Capital BDC, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing amendments to its credit facility and a debt issuance. The Ninth Amendment increased the facility size from $400 million to $500 million, raised the spread to 2.00%, extended the reinvestment period to May 2029 and maturity to May 2031, and reduced the non-usage fee to 0.35%. Separately, the company issued $50 million in Tranche C Notes at 5.97% due 2029 and repaid $111.6 million of existing unsecured notes. These are routine financing activities, not a special situation. No board recommendation or advisors are mentioned.
